metaTitle: Maintenance Engineer | Careers at Firestone UAE
metaDescription: Apply for the Maintenance Engineer role at Firestone Fire and Security Systems, a civil defence approved fire protection contractor in the UAE.

blocks.text: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Maintenance Engineer to handle the installation, inspection, repair, and preventive maintenance of fire and safety systems. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to ensure compliance with safety codes and standards.

items: Perform routine inspection, maintenance, and repair of fire safety systems (fire alarms, sprinklers, extinguishers, hydrants, emergency lighting, etc.).
Troubleshoot system malfunctions and carry out corrective actions promptly.
Plan and execute preventive maintenance schedules for fire protection equipment.
Read and interpret technical manuals, system drawings, and wiring diagrams.
Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, and system performance.
Ensure all work complies with NFPA, civil defense, and local fire authority regulations.
Provide technical support to project teams during installations and upgrades.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams for smooth operations.
Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering field.
Minimum 2 years of experience in maintenance, preferably in fire & safety systems.
Strong knowledge of fire detection, suppression, and safety equipment.
Ability to analyze problems and implement effective solutions.
Good communication skills and professional attitude.
Physically fit and willing to work on-site, including at heights.
Certification in Fire & Safety Engineering or Maintenance.
Familiarity with integrated systems (BMS, access control, CCTV).
Valid safety training certifications (e.g., Electrical Safety, Work at Heights).
Site-based work across various project locations.
May involve emergency service calls, overtime, and weekend shifts.
PPE and tools will be provided by the company.
